about: The same facts about Marc Noah, laid out five ways. The master copy is /index.md.

designs.name: The Coast
designs.idea: Sun, sand and Atlantic blue: the drawn map of the Algarve leads, and his songs follow.

designs.name: Azulejo
designs.idea: Portuguese blue and white tiles: each of his eight songs is a tile.

designs.name: Tour Poster
designs.idea: A screen-printed gig poster: the dates and the towns lead, loud and close.

designs.name: The Songbook
designs.idea: A songwriter’s ruled notebook: one entry per song, in the order he released them.

designs.name: Side A, Side B
designs.idea: A cassette inlay card for the 1980s and 1990s music that shaped his sound: the album as Side A and Side B.
